name: Everything Claude Code
tagline: A complete collection of production Claude Code configs from an Anthropic hackathon winner
description: Everything Claude Code is the full collection of Claude Code configuration built up over 10+ months of intensive daily use: agents (planner, architect, TDD guide, code reviewer, security reviewer, and more), skills, hooks (including memory persistence and strategic compaction), commands, rules, and MCP configurations. It is cross-platform on Windows, macOS, and Linux with Node.js hooks and package-manager auto-detection, and can be installed as a plugin with /plugin marketplace add.
highlights: Battle-tested over 10+ months of daily production use
Agents, skills, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configs in one place
From an Anthropic x Forum Ventures hackathon winner
curatorNote: This is the kind of repo you steal patterns from: memory persistence hooks, strategic compaction, and a working security review agent. If you use Claude Code daily, this is a shortcut to months of accumulated configuration.
